source_name: S&P Global, citing S&P Global Energy CERA data
notes: About 48% of Singapore's 2025 LNG imports, implying total LNG imports near 6.7 Mt (our arithmetic, not a published figure). Qatar shipments stopped in April 2026 due to the Middle East war; EMA secured US, Australian and African replacement cargoes through end 2026.
Gap of about 3 Mt in 2028 and 2029 widening to about 6 Mt by 2035, as GasCo launches its first term LNG tender. Third LNG terminal on Pulau Tekong under study.

source_name: Wood Mackenzie, The Gasco agenda (15 Jul 2025)
notes: WoodMac: existing Indonesian contracts set to expire by 2028; Malaysian pipeline exports expected to end by 2027 (WoodMac view); piped volumes fell about 20% in 2023. West Natuna contract expiry date not independently verified here.

Corridor Block (ConocoPhillips Grissik, Repsol, Pertamina) contract due to expire 2023 was extended five years to 2028 at volumes SKK Migas estimated 30 to 40% lower. Original contract to GSPL was 350 BBtu/d (Katadata 2020).
Sembcorp Gas ended its Sept 2023 GSA for Mako field (West Natuna basin) gas after it failed to get Indonesian approvals. Shows how hard new piped supply is.
